# Convert PayPal transactions into canonical ledger rows
import json
items_out = []
for item in items:
    transactions = item.get('response', {}).get('transaction_details', [])
    for txn in transactions:
        detail = txn.get('transaction_info', {})
        ledger = {
            'processor': 'paypal',
            'processor_account_id': 2,
            'external_id': detail.get('transaction_id'),
            'type': detail.get('transaction_event_code'),
            'gross_amount': float(detail.get('transaction_amount', {}).get('value', 0)),
            'fee_amount': float(detail.get('fee_amount', {}).get('value', 0)),
            'net_amount': float(detail.get('transaction_amount', {}).get('value', 0)) - float(detail.get('fee_amount', {}).get('value', 0)),
            'currency': detail.get('transaction_amount', {}).get('currency_code'),
            'occurred_at': detail.get('transaction_initiation_date'),
            'customer_ref': txn.get('payer_info', {}).get('payer_id', ''),
            'description': detail.get('transaction_subject', ''),
            'status': detail.get('transaction_status')
        }
        items_out.append({'json': ledger})
return items_out
